# FreeTheAI

> FreeTheAI moved to https://freetheai.org. The old API at api.freetheai.xyz is retired; old keys and Discord key signup no longer work.

FreeTheAI is a free, OpenAI-compatible AI API with 50+ models under one account, plus a model marketplace (coming soon).

## Use it

- Sign up: https://freetheai.org/signup (confirm your email with the link we send)
- Create an API key: https://freetheai.org/dashboard/api-keys
- Daily check-in for free models: https://freetheai.org/checkin
- Base URL: https://api.freetheai.org/v1 (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY)
- Model IDs look like fta/<tag>/<model>, for example fta/zai/glm-5.3
- Docs: https://freetheai.org/docs
- Models: https://freetheai.org/models
- Status: https://freetheai.org/status

## Community

- Discord: https://discord.gg/secrets
- GitHub: https://github.com/Free-The-Ai/free-ai
